title: Full IBM-OM standard-crossbar repeat with AIHWKit-default direct signed weights
hypothesis: Replacing the prior abs-max weight scaling and DRN-matched Winsorization with AIHWKit 1.1.0's default unscaled signed-weight path will preserve the exact floating-source function but reduce the programmed signal margin, so post-write apparent accuracy will generally be no higher than in the matched predecessor runs. Method rankings are evaluated descriptively because removing weight scaling and retaining native sampled bounds are a joint intervention requested for this repeat.
motivation: All 29 completed standard-crossbar arm executions used weight_scaling_omega=[1,1] and intersected sampled active-state bounds with [-1,1]. This successor reruns all 28 distinct configurations behind those executions. It copies AIHWKit 1.1.0 semantics: MappingParameter.weight_scaling_omega=0 disables abs-max remapping, the source tensors are passed directly as signed q weights with unit digital scales, the OM preset keeps nominal w_min=-1 and w_max=1, and device-to-device sampled bounds and intrinsic references are retained rather than Winsorized. The frozen teacher already lies inside [-1,1], and off-chip master q remains constrained to [-1,1]. Every other scientific setting is inherited unchanged from the matched predecessor config.

completion_criteria: All 28 distinct successor configs complete exactly once. They cover all 29 completed predecessor arm executions because smoke_supervised_ce_retraining_full_epoch.json was byte-identically reused by two predecessor studies and is deliberately executed once here.

For every successor/predecessor pair, all fields are identical except device.bound_policy changes from winsorize_raw_active_a_to_unit_interval to native_sampled_bounds and mapping changes from omega [1,1] abs-max scaling to omega [0,0] AIHWKit-default no scaling. Seeds, source checkpoint, data, architecture, objective, optimizer, epochs, pulses, transfers, defect policy, and evaluation cohort remain unchanged.

Every run records mapping policy aihwkit_default_no_weight_scaling_direct_q, omega [0,0], digital scales [1,1], direct requested q equal to the tiled teacher tensors, and initial/master q constrained to [-1,1]. The frozen teacher ranges are [-0.6481032372,0.3982129097] and [-0.8516281843,0.5709810257], so no source clipping is needed.

Every sampled population records AIHWKit 1.1.0, nominal OM w_min=-1 and w_max=1, unmodified native per-cell sampled min/max bounds, intrinsic reference, pulse sizes, corruption identity, and any endpoint saturation. A native bound may extend outside [-1,1] because w_min_dtod and w_max_dtod are part of the preset; this is not treated as remapping.
All headline deployment and recovery conclusions use post-write apparent-state accuracy. Persistent-state accuracy is reported alongside it on the same cohort as a robustness diagnostic.

Artifact verification succeeds for every run, including config and input hashes, population receipts, state hashes, optimizer/update counts, endpoint accounting, and declared transfer assignments. Failed attempts remain visible and are not silently substituted.

The repeat remains model-based evidence from the fitted AIHWKit OM preset. It does not establish behavior of a fabricated array, absolute conductance or power, line resistance, retention, drift, endurance, or fresh-read robustness.
analysis_plan: First audit successor/predecessor config parity mechanically and verify direct-q identity, unit digital scales, native-bound receipts, all 39700 cell identities, and exact test-cohort parity.

For every predecessor arm, report successor and predecessor apparent/persistent metrics side by side, with absolute percentage-point deltas. Keep source assignment and fresh-array assignment means separate; repeated endpoint writes are not independent arrays.

Within the successor study, reproduce each predecessor study's original contrasts: direct versus continuous HWA versus QAT, repaired versus published defects, exact versus support-clamped handoff, deterministic versus stochastic HWA, crossed defect policies, and recovery methods.

Do not attribute a successor/predecessor delta separately to no weight scaling or native sampled bounds, because both were intentionally changed together. A causal decomposition would require two additional factorial controls.

Check whether source exact-mapping predictions remain identical before hardware exposure. If not, fail the study because disabling mapping with unit scales should preserve the mathematical floating network exactly.

Report saturation, verify exhaustion, pulse/read counts, state ranges, and apparent-minus-persistent gaps with accuracy so any change can be connected to reduced physical-q utilization or retained native support rather than described only as a score delta.

Apply the original decision thresholds only within their corresponding predecessor comparison, and label any cross-study observation descriptive. Preserve the original smoke/full-data and debug/formal evidence classifications.
